message.content: There is no specific mention of Li Hua and Yuriko Yamamoto meeting to show the final website. The only interaction between them regarding a website is during a conversation where Li Hua shared feedback on a demo website he had shown her, suggesting improvements for the color scheme and adding a community outreach section. There is also a reference to a website where Yuriko Yamamoto mentioned she would inform her colleagues about her absence from a jam session due to work commitments. However, there is no indication of a final website presentation or the location where they would meet to view it.
